name: CUV18f1
description: Imperial forces used Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport CUV18f1 during the Galactic Civil War. Transport CUV18f1 reloaded warheads for essential TIE starfighters attacking the MC40a light cruiser Warhawk and the Victory-class Star Destroyer Protector at the Treachery at Ottega.
